title: Tech Note: An Introduction to Drag and Drop

historical_commentary.text: Drag and drop in 4D v6 required manual handling of form events and pointers. Modern 4D (v17+) still supports drag and drop via form events, but the underlying framework, object model, and event handling have been significantly modernized. The core concepts of reusable generic code and pointer-based abstraction remain sound programming principles.
related_updates: 4D's form event model has been modernized but drag and drop still relies on form events
Project Mode and ORDA have changed how developers structure reusable code
